name: kody-w
description: The kody-w twin brain repo. The canonical source of Kody Wildfeuer's digital twin — soul.md, vault notes (Obsidian-format), agents, memory. Public corpus the kody-w.egg in rapp-egg-hub points its private_companion at; collaborators with read access pull this for richer context, anonymous visitors see only what's in the egg itself.
_attestation_note: When kody-w/RAPP adopts release signing, this variant's attestation will be issued by rapp's release key asserting (parent_rappid, parent_commit, child_rappid).

brainstem._note: This variant bundles its own copy of the brainstem kernel for local-first operation. Re-running installer/initialize-variant.sh will NEVER re-sync or overwrite it. To pull upstream kernel updates, run a deliberate manual sync (compare against source_commit).
